name: Lit Sphere Shading
definition: A non-photorealistic rendering technique that captures artistic lighting by using an image of a sphere shaded in the desired style as a lookup table. The shading of an object is represented as a function of eye-space normal orientation, allowing the sphere to act as a proxy object for illumination.
summary: Lit Sphere Shading is a non-photorealistic technique that uses a pre-shaded sphere image as a lookup table to apply artistic lighting based on normal orientation, distinguishing itself by relying on a geometric proxy rather than scalar fields or analytical calculations.
